_comment: Copy to pipeline/character/<video>/approval.json. Written at gate A (P1), gate B (P3) and gate C (P6), with the user's words.

gate_b_segments.identity: face, hair and signature details match the creator file in every second
gate_b_segments.mouth: lip sync holds; transcript matches the script
gate_b_segments.voice: matches the voice reference; natural-voice check passes: natural breaths, varied pauses, pitch spread passes, room sound, no flat TTS cadence
gate_b_segments.set: same room, light and camera position; nothing hallucinated
gate_b_segments.insert_gates: see insert.json gates, the flat-on gate first; n/a without a phone
gate_b_segments.decision: approve | reject | regenerate this segment only
gate_b_segments.failure_class: <for a reject: the ledger row it adds>

gate_c_final.ui_real_and_readable: OCR of the hero element passes on the final file; n/a without app insertion
gate_c_final.captions: match the frozen script and the house style
gate_c_final.words: <the user's words, quoted, with the date>
